novelty: First prospective tiny next-symbol temporal prediction study instead of paired-order judgment; preserve 16-state/64-count capacity across all comparators.
question: Can a 16-context online counting learner infer a compositional second-order predictive rule and transfer its learned transition table to new episodes, outperforming one-step and order-destroyed representations?
hypothesis: Order-two state memory will predict unseen episodes significantly better than last observation plus episode group and order-scrambled context, under identical train examples and context capacities.
freeze: All splits, exact Fibonacci-style modular recurrence, perturbation controls, capacity, metrics and thresholds fixed before first scientific run; no post-result tuning or replay.
generator: For seed S each of 16 episodes e=0..15 has initial x0=(e+S)%4,x1=((e//4)+3*S)%4. For t>=2, xt=(x[t-1]+x[t-2])%4 through 32 observations. 16 episodes traverse all 16 initial-state combinations per seed; finite deterministic and synthetic, not a claim of OOD dynamics.
arms: order_two: exact 16 contexts=(x[t-2],x[t-1]), each 4-class count row
last_plus_episode: exact 16 contexts=(x[t-1],e%4), each 4-class count row
shuffled_order_two: exact 16 contexts from a fixed even-index-before-odd-index temporal permutation of the sequence, labels remain unshuffled xt
training: Identical 4 seeds x 16 episodes x 30 transitions per arm; counters start zero, one-pass add 1 to observed target count. Predict class argmax over 4 with tie fixed lowest class. No heldout updates.
evaluation: Exactly 4 sealed heldout seeds x16 episodes x30 predictions per arm. All 16 contexts must be seen in training (report unobserved count). Report per-seed exact next-symbol accuracy, confusion and trace hash; count training examples and table footprint 16x4 each.
primary: ORDER_TWO_PREDICTIVE_TRANSFER if order_two heldout accuracy>=.95 and both controls<=.65; PARTIAL_TRANSFER if order_two exceeds both controls without meeting full criterion; NEGATIVE_TRANSFER otherwise.
controls: All symbols in {0,1,2,3}, shuffled input preserves complete symbol histogram and only destroys order, same counts and evaluation examples; no labels or future outcomes into predictor at inference; exact hash provenance and one full regression.
claim_limit: Memorized finite synthetic second-order recurrence on disjoint episodes, not language intelligence or unseen rule adaptation.
